title: 第7章 击杀！入门！发劲！
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“怎么，觉得我的属性不对？”

罗兰神色冰冷。

他看着这个和自己一个觉醒室的人，深深吸了一口气。

徐海的实力并不差，但是在开启了一阶基因锁的他面前，却脆弱得像是一只鸡。

而在这个时候，属于丧尸的嘶吼声，正在不断响起，向他们逼近！

“饶了我！”徐海恐惧的看着罗兰，目光崩溃。

罗兰正想说些什么的时候，徐海却突然猛地开口，一口蕴含丧尸病毒的鲜血朝着罗兰直接喷出！

鲜血宛如水雾，然而却根本没有击中罗兰！

在徐海准备暗算罗兰的一瞬间，罗兰便察觉到了他的打算，在徐海开口的前一刻，他便闪身躲开了这一击。

看到自己这一招没有成功，徐海这才彻底绝望。

“本来还想问你一些东西，但是......没时间跟你浪费了！”

看着徐海死不悔改的样子，再听到丧尸快速靠近的动静，罗兰心中一狠，旋即手掌用力，便直接掐断了徐海的脖子。

“呼！”

看着被自己亲手击杀的徐海，罗兰神色不变，只是长长出了一口气。

他伸手将小型治疗药剂从徐海身上取下，重新放回自己的药剂腰带上面。

随后，罗兰将长刀从墙壁上还有徐海的尸体中拔出，目光看向身后。

身后，一群丧尸已经逼近。

“还剩四十秒！”

念头闪过，罗兰朝着走廊中的丧尸直接扑了过去。

他长刀连连挥砍，刀光闪烁，一只只丧尸的头颅被刀刃砍下，效率飞快！

原本罗兰的刀法还没有这么犀利，但是在一阶基因锁带来的10级战斗本能加持下，罗兰此刻的刀法，已经超出了2级的范畴！

罗兰一路横冲直撞，宛如虎入羊群，一颗颗丧尸头颅飞起，一道道宛如喷泉般的血液从丧尸脖子处的整齐切口喷涌！

不过这些血液并没有对罗兰造成任何威胁，在它们落下来之前，在这些血液弥散在空气中靠近罗兰之前，罗兰已经远离了这个地方。

在一阶基因锁持续时间还剩下十秒的时候，罗兰找了个安全的房间，将大门牢牢封闭后，随即又快速搜查了一下房间，发现没有任何威胁之后，这才坐在了沙发上等待！

他在等待一阶基因锁持续时间结束之后的反噬！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Why, do you think my attributes are wrong?"

Roland looked cold.

He looked at the person in the same awakening room with him and took a deep breath.

Xu Hai's strength is not bad, but in front of him who has unlocked the first-level gene lock, he is as fragile as a chicken.

At this time, the roars of zombies were sounding continuously, approaching them!

"Spare me!" Xu Hai looked at Roland in fear, his eyes collapsed.

When Roland was about to say something, Xu Hai suddenly spoke suddenly and sprayed a mouthful of blood containing the zombie virus directly towards Roland!

The blood was like mist, but it didn't hit Roland at all!

The moment Xu Hai was about to plot against Roland, Roland noticed his plan, and the moment before Xu Hai opened his mouth, he dodged the attack.

Seeing that his move was unsuccessful, Xu Hai was completely desperate.

"I wanted to ask you something, but... I don't have time to waste with you!"

Seeing Xu Hai's unrepentant look, and then hearing the zombies approaching quickly, Roland felt cruel, and immediately used his palms to pinch Xu Hai's neck.

"Phew!"

Looking at Xu Hai who was killed by himself, Roland's expression remained unchanged and he just let out a long breath.

He reached out and took off the small healing potion from Xu Hai and put it back on his potion belt.

Then, Roland pulled out the long knife from the wall and Xu Hai's body, and looked behind him.

Behind him, a group of zombies were approaching.

"Forty seconds left!"

The thought flashed through his mind, and Roland pounced directly towards the zombies in the corridor.

He slashed repeatedly with his long knife, the light of the knife flashed, and the heads of zombies were chopped off by the blade, very efficiently!

Originally, Roland's sword skills were not so sharp, but with the blessing of level 10 combat instinct brought by the first-level gene lock, Roland's sword skills at this moment have exceeded the level 2 level!

Roland rushed all the way, like a tiger entering a flock of sheep, zombie heads flew up one after another, and streams of blood spurted out like fountains from the neat incisions on the zombies' necks!

However, the blood did not pose any threat to Roland. Before it fell, before the blood dispersed in the air and approached Roland, Roland had already moved away from this place.

When there were still ten seconds left in the duration of the first-level gene lock, Roland found a safe room. After sealing the door firmly, he quickly searched the room and found that there was no threat. Then he sat on the sofa and waited!

He is waiting for the backlash after the first-order gene lock duration ends!
